# Starfall Pyrotechnics

> Award-winning professional firework and drone display company based in Harrogate, North Yorkshire, firing displays across the UK since 1971. BPA-trained crews, £10m public liability insurance, and digital choreography for weddings, corporate events, Bonfire Night, and public celebrations.

Starfall Pyrotechnics designs, choreographs and fires professional firework and drone light displays for private, public and corporate clients. We are British Championship-recognised, fully insured (£10m public liability), and work to the Explosives Regulations 2014. We serve Yorkshire, Lancashire, the North East, the Midlands and London, and travel nationwide for larger commissions.

## Services

- [Firework Displays (hub)](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays): Overview of every display type we offer.
- [Wedding Fireworks](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays/weddings): Tailored wedding displays from £595, including first-dance pyromusicals and low-noise options.
- [Wedding Packages](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays/wedding-packages): Three-tier packages (Sparkle, Celebration, Showstopper) plus add-ons.
- [Bonfire Night Displays](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays/bonfire-night): Public 5th November displays at any scale, procurement-friendly.
- [Corporate & TV](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays/corporate): Brand launches, concerts, festivals and broadcast pyrotechnics.
- [Councils & National Events](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays/public-events): Procurement-ready public displays with full risk assessments and barge/rooftop firing.
- [Pyromusicals](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays/pyromusicals): Fireworks choreographed to music with 3D preview and digital firing.
- [Special Effects](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/displays/special-effects): Lasers, CO2 jets, confetti, snow, stage flames and close-proximity pyro.
- [Drone Shows](https://www.starfallpyro.co.uk/drone-shows): Programmable drone light shows, pyro drones, and combined drone-and-firework finales.

## Key differentiators

- Established 1971 with British Championship-winning display designers.
- BPA-trained firing crews and full compliance with the Explosives Regulations 2014.
- £10 million public liability insurance and site-specific risk assessments on every booking.
- Digital, computerised firing for frame-accurate pyromusicals.
- Low-noise display options for venues near livestock, homes or with sensitive guests.
- Combined drone-and-firework shows for a modern, shareable spectacle.

## FAQ summary

- Cost: Displays start from £595; most private events fall between £995 and £2,500.
- Booking lead time: 3–6 months recommended; Bonfire Night dates book out by August.
- Insurance: £10m public liability, certificates available on request.
- Low-noise: Available and every bit as visually spectacular as standard displays.
- Weather: Rain rarely stops a display; high wind is the main safety factor. Postponements are rescheduled at no extra cost.
- Areas served: Yorkshire, Lancashire, North East, Midlands, London, and nationwide for larger events.
